MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    result = 1

    if k == 0:
        for i in range(1, p):
            result = (result * p) % MOD
        print(result)
        return

    if k == 1:
        for i in range(p):
            result = (result * p) % MOD
        print(result)
        return

    power = [1] * (p + 1)
    for i in range(1, p + 1):
        power[i] = (power[i - 1] * k) % p

    visited = [False] * p
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not visited[i]:
            j = i
            length = 0
            while True:
                visited[j] = True
                length += 1
                j = (k * j) % p
                if visited[j]:
                    break
            if power[length] == 1:
                result = (result * p) % MOD

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
